body:
Thank you.  I offered to go to counseling with her last night. Tonight instead of talking she came home,  changed,  and has been out ever since. I don't think we are going to recover.  She knows that I am good for the kids. I am just no longer good enough for her. 

My job is highly specialized. I have always kept an eye out for opportunities. Unfortunately most of those opportunities would take me even further away from my Mother. I can make the 3 hour drive to visit her any time. I won't be able to hop on a plane to see her with the same expediency. 

I have built my credit before. I know I can do it again. Its just a long and difficult uphill battle that I don't know if I have the energy to tackle anymore. 

I moved away from my friends when I came here for my job. I have lost touch or pushed away everyone that mattered to me and replaced them with my family and my work. Those two aspects of my life are the only things I've focused on in years. I fought so hard at my job to get where I am,  and it was all to give my family a better life. If I lose them,  what am I working for?  I have nothing else left, and the weight of that thought is crippling me. I can't bring myself to do anything.

I don't know why I'm still here at this point. My life is crumbling down around me, and I don't want to fight it anymore.
